posts.excerpt: Blackwell Ultra ramp is tracking ahead of street — hyperscaler capex commentary this quarter will be the tell.
NVDA's pricing power on inference SKUs is the underappreciated story; gross margin trajectory matters more than headline revenue.
Reiterating long NVDA into print — sell-side numbers still look stale on networking attach rates.
Sovereign AI deals announced this week add real bookings visibility through FY27. Underrated.
Three hyperscaler CFOs reaffirmed AI capex on calls this week. Doesn't read like the digestion bears are calling for.
Custom silicon at the top 3 hyperscalers is real. Doesn't kill NVDA but compresses the share-of-wallet ceiling people are modeling.
Sentiment, positioning, and valuation are all stretched here. Doesn't mean the top is in, but the asymmetry has flipped.
Insider selling at NVDA continues to accelerate per the latest Form 4 filings. Always nothing, until it isn't.
If China export controls tighten further this quarter, the H20-class revenue line goes to zero. Tail risk, not base case.
NVDA print next week. Bar is high but not unreasonable given the data center comps.
Semi sentiment is rolling over at the index level even as NVDA holds up. Worth watching for a breadth divergence.
Watching gross margin guide more than the revenue number. That's the variable that actually moves the multiple here.
